This follows by the defining chart measure identity for the exponential followed by right Haar invariance. On the finite set of active links, take the product of these maps. Product measure and multiplication of densities give the exact joint density Q i cJ(ai) on the product chart ball, with the product of the restricted Haar measures as its image. The inactive links are held fixed.
